newsitem.title: UK: Barclays buys shares back at 1137.27p.
newsitem.headline: Barclays buys shares back at 1137.27p.

text.p: British banking group Barclays Plc said on Wednesday that it had bought 9.2 million shares for cancellation today at 1137.27p per share.
Barclays said earlier today that it planned to buy back up to 26 million ordinary shares representing 1.7 percent of its ordinary share capital.
Today's purchases represented around 0.6 percent of its ordinary share capital.

"While it is encouraging in many ways that there are not enough sellers of the shares at the current price to enable us to complete our planned purchase this morning, we remain committed to returning capital to shareholders and shall be looking to buy further shares as appropriate," said chief executive Martin Taylor.
